sources.title: nlpai-lab/KURE-Reranker-nano · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: KURE-Reranker-nano is a lightweight, approximately 150M-parameter Korean-English bilingual reranker. It jointly encodes a query and a candidate document and predicts a scalar relevance score.
